name: Goldenstedt (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of blue, red and blue with a broad red middle stripe, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Goldenstedt (a red ring of bezants and a crozier on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Goldenstedt; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Goldenstedt arms — bezants and crozier on yellow
